# New Element Group

> > New Element is a China-based manufacturer of fiber cement and calcium silicate boards for residential, commercial, and industrial construction applications.

New Element Group specializes in producing high-performance building materials including fiber cement boards, calcium silicate boards, and related products for exterior cladding, interior partitions, and specialized applications. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Foshan, China and serves global markets with certified, fire-resistant building solutions.

## Key Topics

- Fiber Cement Board
- Calcium Silicate Board
- Cladboard
- Wonderpan
- Siding Plank
- Cherrypan
- Backerpan
- Fire-resistant
- Building Materials
- Manufacturing
- ISO Certifications

- Interior Partition Solutions
- Explosion Protection

## Core Products

- [Fiber Cement Board](https://newelementgroup.com/products/fiber-cement-board.html): Fiber cement board product line including cladding and interior applications
- [All Products](https://newelementgroup.com/products/all-products.html): Product catalog featuring Cladboard, Wonderpan, and Siding Plank solutions

## Product Applications

- [Interior Partition & Ceiling Solutions](https://newelementgroup.com/products/interior-partition-ceiling.html): Interior partition and ceiling solutions with Cherrypan and Backerpan products
- [Interior Decoration](https://newelementgroup.com/products/interior-decoration.html): Decorative fiber cement boards including Wonderpan and Gentlepan for interiors
- [Explosion Protection](https://newelementgroup.com/products/explosion-protection.html): Blast-resistant Ventingpan and Blastboard for explosion protection applications
